name: Playboxai
tagline: Browser AI video studio: two watermarked free generations a day, one-time credits that do not expire, and prompts that are not secretly rewr
description: Playboxai is a browser AI video studio and an independent alternative to Playbox-branded sites. You can start from a still photo, describe the motion, and generate a short clip. The official homepage states two free watermarked generations each day; paid one-time credit packs remove the watermark. Credits are not a subscription and, under the current plan, do not expire. The workspace shows an estimated cost before you submit, and a failed job shows a refund notice when the provider refunds the charge. Public pack prices in U.S. dollars were not readable on the official pricing page (placeholders only). Uncensored here means the prompt is not secretly rewritten; adult-friendly swimsuit or boudoir scenes may be allowed, but nude, porn, clothes-removal, and intimate clips of a real person without consent are not.
